summary: The documentation is accurate, but its opening API summary is a sentence fragment.

items.issue: The first sentence begins with the noun phrase “A base class ...” and has no finite verb, so it is a fragment rather than the required standalone declarative API-index summary.
items.suggestion: Use a complete first sentence, e.g. “`AbstractFunction19` is a base class for nineteen-parameter function implementations.” Keep the explanation about extending a class as a following sentence.
